repos_data.description: Official TypeScript & Python SDKs + MCP integration for the Lumify sports-intelligence API: schedules, live scores, odds, betting splits, and explainable bet confidence.
Official MCP server for Odds-API.io: live sports betting odds from 365+ bookmakers in Claude, Cursor and other AI tools

Python MCP server for ParlayAPI sports odds and props. Public discovery needs no key; account data uses your own key. Includes signup, login-email, checkout-link and preference actions. MIT code; API data redistribution rights are not included.
Odds API MCP server: read-only OddsRelay odds data for Claude, Cursor and other AI tools, with a token cap on every call that spends tokens.
PuntersEdge MCP server: live Australian racing and sports odds from 15 Australian bookmakers inside Claude, Cursor and any MCP client. Horse, greyhound and harness racing plus AFL, NRL and NBA.
